additional_info.subject: Case 0473947 - Issue Resolved, Closing Ticket
additional_info.body:
Dear Harun,
Thank you for the handover and troubleshooting request.
Update on the situation:
We have already performed on-site troubleshooting together with the ÖAMTC technician and Johannes.
Findings:
DC12 fuse was active
All other DC fuses were not active
The issue has been identified and resolved on-site. The charger is now operational.
We are closing this ticket.
If you need any further documentation or information, please let me know.
Best regards,
Laurenz Stelzl
